rules: When interpreting a question, consider both the direct and indirect ecological effects of an event, and evaluate all possible impacts on the system in question, not just the most observable ones.
When answering questions, ensure that you interpret the context fully and evaluate each option specifically in relation to that context, not just in general terms.

Ensure to fully evaluate all given properties and consider the possibility of natural variances, even within the same material composition, before concluding which property is most likely to be the same.
